PART I

Item 4. Information on ASML

A. History and Development of the Company

ASML was incorporated in the Netherlands in 1984.

B. Business Overview

ASML is a leading supplier of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry. We provide manufacturers with hardware, software and services to mass produce patterns on silicon.

C. Organizational Structure

We operate through a group of wholly owned subsidiaries.
